jobs.title: Experienced Level III Commissioned Security Officer (School Campus Assignment)
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking professional, disciplined, and experienced Level III Commissioned Security Officers to support school-based safety and protection. This role is ideal for officers who take pride in their appearance, communication, and tactical readiness — and who want to work in a mission-driven environment that values professionalism and leadership.

If you want to make a meaningful impact on campus safety while working alongside educators, families, and law enforcement, this is the position for you.

What You'll Do

As a commissioned officer assigned to a school campus, you will:

  • Serve as a visible, trusted security presence for students and staff
  • Conduct interior and exterior patrols
  • Respond to incidents, disturbances, and emergencies
  • Maintain strong communication and de-escalation standards
  • Prepare accurate and timely incident and daily activity reports
  • Partner closely with school administrators and local law enforcement
  • Demonstrate sound judgment and situational awareness
  • Uphold the highest standards of professionalism and accountability

This is a position where your demeanor and decision-making matter as much as your tactical skill set

Minimum Requirements

To be considered, candidates must have:

  • Active Texas DPS Level III Commissioned License
  • 21+ years of age
  • High School diploma or GED
  • Valid Texas driver's license
  • Reliable transportation and a working mobile phone
  • Strong firearm handling and safety proficiency
  • Ability to pass background screening and physical fitness assessment
  • Strong writing, communication, and observation skills
  • Ability to work independently with professionalism and integrity

Disqualifiers (No Exceptions)

  • Felony conviction within 10 years
  • Class A Misdemeanor within 5 years
  • Class B Misdemeanor within 2 years
  • Any domestic/family violence conviction
  • Any open charges or deferred adjudication for felony or Class A/B misdemeanor

Required Duty Gear (Officer-Provided)

  • Service-caliber duty firearm (Glock, SIG Sauer, S&W, H&K — 9mm/.40/.45)
  • Level III retention holster no dropdown or thigh holster
  • Full duty belt setup
  • OD Green tactical pants
  • Flashlight, handcuffs, and other standard duty accessories

Preferred Experience

We strongly value applicants with:

  • Prior military or law enforcement background
  • Previous school security or SRO-style experience
  • Advanced firearm proficiency
  • Demonstrated report writing excellence
  • Strong interpersonal, conflict-resolution, and leadership skills

Schedule & Physical Standards

  • Must be able to work all shifts, including weekends or holidays if required
  • Must maintain a clean-cut, professional appearance
  • Ability to walk, stand, run, climb, or sit for extended periods
  • Able to work outdoors in all weather conditions

Why Join Us?

  • Stable, long-term school assignments
  • Professional work environment
  • Opportunities for additional hours
  • Serve in a meaningful, high-impact role
  • Be part of a team committed to safety, professionalism, and excellence

Pay 20.00 to 22.00

jobs.title: Loss Prevention Agent
jobs.description:
Loss Prevention Agent

Job Summary:

The primary responsibility of a Loss Prevention Agent & Security Officer at The Westin San Diego Gaslamp Quarter is to ensure the welfare and security of guests, employees, and infrastructure. You will be tasked with conducting regular rounds, attending to urgent situations, monitoring surveillance equipment, and enforcing safety protocols throughout the premises. This role is instrumental in creating a safe and hospitable setting for all patrons.

Benefits:

  • Health care coverage
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Paid leave encompasses both scheduled time off, like vacation days, and unscheduled time off, such as sick days
  • Life and disability insurance serve as crucial safety nets for individuals and their families by providing financial stability during difficult times. These insurance policies can help ease the financial burden that comes with unexpected events, such as illness, injury, or death
  • Wellness programs

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform regular checks in all sections of the property and support guests in gaining room entry.
  • Supervise surveillance cameras, intrusion alerts, and emergency response mechanisms.
  • Reacting to events, such as accidents, crises, and disturbances.
  • Offer primary aid and CPR support while liaising with emergency responders if required.
  • Escort individuals who do not have authorization out of the premises if needed.
  • Create comprehensive documentation of incidents and operational tasks; oversee the upkeep of security registers.
  • Inspect for safety risks and document maintenance concerns.
  • Ensure that doors are locked or unlocked as per the designated timings.
  • Ensure the privacy of reports and confidential data.
  • Offer support for investigations by interviewing relevant parties as necessary.
  • Ensure strict compliance with the company's safety and security protocols.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Educational Qualification: Possession of a high school diploma or a comparable GED qualification.
  • No prior exposure necessary for this position.
  • Licenses or certifications are not obligatory, although state-specific prerequisites might need to be met.
  • Required to lift objects weighing up to 50 pounds and demonstrate agility during unexpected events.
  • Proficient in communicating clearly through both spoken and written language.
  • Maintaining a sense of tranquility when faced with pressure and managing conflicts in a mature manner.

About Us:

We at Westin, which is under the umbrella of Marriott International, are devoted to supporting our guests and staff to reach their maximum potential. Our ethos revolves around promoting well-being, inclusivity, and opportunities for all. Join us as we strive to build a stable and nurturing environment where both guests and team members can prosper.

Company Overview:

Allied Universal, North America's leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Allied Universal is hiring a Security Professional Flex Officer. The Security Professional Flex Officer will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Healthcare, Education, Finance and more. Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Security Professional Flex Officer, you'll use our exclusive shift-pickup platform to view and claim open shifts based on your availability - giving you the freedom to build a schedule that works for you, while gaining valuable site experience across various industries. Whether you're looking to supplement your income or take the first step toward a phenomenal career, this position offers unmatched access to hands-on experience and growth opportunities. The Security Professional Flex Officer may be called upon to work irregular shifts at times with little to no advance notice.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Perform security patrols of designated areas on foot or in vehicle
  • Watch for irregular or unusual conditions that may create security concerns or safety hazards
  • Sound alarms or calls police or fire department in case of fire or presence of unauthorized persons
  • Warn violators of rule infractions, such as loitering, smoking, or carrying forbidden articles
  • Permit authorized persons to enter property and monitors entrances and exits
  • Observe departing personnel to protect against theft of company property and ensures that authorized removal of property is conducted within appropriate client requirements
  • Investigate and prepare reports on accidents, incidents, and suspicious activities; maintain written logs as required by the post
  • Aid customers, employees, and visitors in a courteous and professional manner
  • Make emergency notifications as necessary pursuant to site Post Orders

QUALIFICATIONS (MUST HAVE):

  • Must possess a high school diploma or equivalent or 5 years of verifiable experience
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment
  • Valid driver's license if driving a company or customer-owned vehicle
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws; Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law
  • No prior experience required
  • Be at least 18 years of age, or higher if required by the state (21 years, if armed)
  • Reliability and ability to adapt to different post assignments
  • Be able to operate radio or telephone equipment and/or console monitors
  • Demonstrated ability to interact cordially and communicate with the public
  • Effective oral and written communication skills; able to write informatively, clearly, and accurately
  • Active listening and problem-solving skills
  • Assess and evaluate situations effectively; identify critical issues quickly and accurately
  • Mediate conflict with tact, diplomacy
  • Teamwork
  • Attention to detail

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS (NICE TO HAVE):

  • Ability to speak, read, and write in multiple languages (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, French, Arabic)
  • Prior security, military, or law enforcement experience

BENEFITS:

  • Health insurance and 401k plans for full-time positions
  • Schedules that fit with your personal life goals
  • Ongoing paid training programs and career growth opportunities
  • Employee discounts through our perks program to your favorite restaurants, entertainment venues and much more…

jobs.title: Security Officer - Overnight Entry Control Driver
jobs.description:
About the position

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve. Job Description As a Security Officer - Overnight Entry Control Driver in Lewisville, TX , you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Logistics & Distribution, and more. Join Allied Universal at a busy logistics and distribution location, where you will support access control by greeting drivers and visitors, checking credentials, managing entry and exit points, and documenting activity. You will remain highly visible, complete routine patrols of assigned areas, and communicate clearly with site teams to help reduce security-related incidents. This is a driving post, so a valid driver’s license is required.

Responsibilities

  • Provide customer service to employees, visitors, and drivers by following Allied Universal security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and when appropriate, emergency response activities at a logistics and distribution location.
  • Control access at entry points by verifying identification, managing visitor and contractor check-in and/or check-out, issuing temporary credentials when authorized, and maintaining accurate access logs.
  • Monitor inbound and outbound activity including trucks and trailers by confirming appointments, checking documentation as directed, and coordinating with site personnel to help support orderly flow through gates and docks.
  • Respond to incidents and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, including reporting hazards, policy violations, and suspicious activity according to post orders.
  • Conduct regular and random patrols of entrances, staging areas, and perimeter routes, watching for unsecured doors, broken fencing, and irregular activity; working environments and conditions may vary by site.

Requirements

  • Have at least 6+ months of security-related experience.
  • Be at least 21+ years of age.
  • A valid driver’s license is required in accordance with Allied Universal driver policy requirements.
  • Be comfortable using a computer or tablet preferred.
  • At this site there are limited on-site facilities such as portable toilets and rustic guard shacks.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Benefits

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.
